technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 500g, this KoColor BATH_PRODUCT is expertly formulated with 100% Pure Magnesium Sulfate and Eucalyptus Essential Oil. It delivers a high-fidelity Crystalline White color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages transdermal mineral absorption.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Dissolve 2 cups in a warm bath. Soak for a minimum of 20 minutes to allow for optimal transdermal uptake.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Do not use soap during a magnesium soak, as the surfactants can alter the water's chemistry and impede mineral absorption.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Formulated exclusively with USP-grade magnesium sulfate for maximum biological bioavailability.
